Must be five inches close to the ground to show respect; That was added by Great Master Nguich Ich, because he relied on the sadhana in all the meditations. We have just preached the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Contemplation Sutra, [you see the main sutra] does not say anything, it only says that you sincerely pay homage to all Buddhas in the ten directions, sincerely pay homage to all Dharma treasures in the ten directions, sincerely pay homage to all sages in the ten directions, sincerely pay homage to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat. To the Buddhas of the ten directions one bows, to the ten methods one bows, to the sages and saints of the ten directions one bows, but to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva one bows three times. That is the first step if you want to use Chiem Sat Luan.

The second step is to make offerings. We must use incense and flowers to make offerings to the Buddhas of the ten directions, or to make offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Must recite "Seriously hold the scent of flowers, like the dharma of offerings" (solemnly hold the fragrant flowers, like the dharma of offerings). May this cloud of fragrant flowers fill the ten dharma realms, make offerings to all Buddhas, venerable Dharmas, and sages, receive and perform Buddha's work in the boundless Buddha realms. After reciting once, then bow once. This is the second thing to do.

The third thing is to identify yourself. When we want to use the Contemplation Wheel, we should kneel in front of the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and pray. I myself vow: "The disciple's name is...". For example, when I bowed, I said: "My disciple's name is Mong Tham. Currently, I am an ordinary person in birth and death. My sins are deeply and deeply hindered. I do not know the cause and effect of my karma in three generations. I hold many doubts. I myself do not know whether my karma is heavy or light. I am very skeptical. I respectfully request Bodhisattva and respectfully rely on the three types of rotation taught by Bodhisattva." If you want to use the wheel form, you must address it to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, in accordance with the dharma of contemplation, wholeheartedly respectfully pray to Ksitigarbha for mercy, pray that He will use his great compassion, support, save, guide, help you eliminate doubts, and teach you! At that time, we still have to kneel with both knees close to the ground, that is, we kneel straight, clasp our hands and recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, we have to recite a thousand sentences. There are many Dharma friends who do not follow the sadhana when praying. If you don't follow the sadhana, it won't be effective, and the Samskara Contemplation you gain is not trustworthy. That is fake, false. You must follow the sadhana to do it.

After finishing, whatever you wish for, whatever you pray for, you must tell Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, facing the object. You should not doubt that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva does not hear, and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva does not appear, so he is not spiritual. No doubt at all! While you are bowing and making offerings, the Ksitigarbha Sutra says, but the Sutra on Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma has not yet said, [the Ksitigarbha Sutra] says that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will definitely appear. Otherwise, you will not be able to use the Contemplation Wheel. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva is very compassionate and compassionate. He will protect my thoughts and protect all sentient beings. Suppose you ask Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for something, first of all, you must think about all sentient beings, not just ask for yourself. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is great and compassionate. You must make a vow, you must develop a mind to be in harmony with Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Just for yourself is not enough, you must dedicate it to sentient beings. If we have a lot of doubts and don't know how to do it, please ask the Bodhisattva to teach us. If we sow the wheel, the form will correspond. The form of the wheel sown by me and what Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva taught in the scriptures corresponds, that is called “correspondence”. That's called “ritual”. If you want to use the Contemplation Wheel, first perform that ritual, then you can use the Contemplation Wheel for contemplation. It's not like taking the [wood wheel] and immediately sowing it; [If you sow immediately] it will not be effective. Whatever you pray for, you can achieve pure good karma, or you can also achieve pure evil karma. Depending on what you pray for, the form of reincarnation will appear.

This is like guessing hexagrams. Worshiping, making offerings, naming names, and making requests as above have all been done; Then, first contemplate the wheel form of the first group. At the beginning, you have just entered the penitentiary, not knowing which of your ten karmas is the heaviest. Four karma of mouth, three karma of body, three karma of mind; First of all, you should use these ten types for contemplation. Contemplating the wheel, what is displayed is the Ten Good Karmas, or the Ten Evil Karmas, which items do you complete? Based on that, you contemplate the wheel form of the second group. In order, contemplate the three karma in the body; Then contemplate the four karmas of the mouth, then contemplate the three karmas of the mind. When repenting, other things will not be used. If your karma is heavy, just repent of that karma. After bowing for seven days, you can use Chiem Sat Luan. [If you don't repent] and use it immediately, it will absolutely not be effective. At first, you will discover that [the wheel form shows rough black lines. After you have worshiped for a week, [if you are] a living being with light karma, you will be able to worship and contemplate and it will be effective. Living beings with heavy karma will not be spiritual. Please bow for another week. Use it for a maximum of twenty-one days and the effect will be effective.

The wheel form of the second group must coordinate with the first group, coordinate with the ten karma. Contemplation of Wood Wheel in the first group shows that [the practitioner who casts Contemplation of Wood Wheel] "does not kill, does not steal, does not have sexual karma". That is good karma. When you plant the second group, it will all be black, which means evil. That's called "no correspondence". The first group must correspond to the second group. The first group is pure, the second group must also sow purity. The first group is pure, the second group is not pure, it is an illusion, not the truth. After corresponding, you will know which karma is heavy among the Ten Virtues and Evils of the body, mouth, and mind. You repent of your heavy karma first, repenting specifically for the evil karma in your body. Having repented of one's body karma, one will repent of other karma. That is called repentance and contemplation. That's what I tell everyone in general. If you understand this, everything else will be understood. But when you want to bow to Chiem Sat Sam, the first thing is to demonstrate purity of body and mind. When you first use the [Contemplation Wheel], you must take a bath, your clothes must be pure, and enter the penance room. If you don't have a penance room, then in your own bedroom, you need to clean it up a bit and make it a bit more pure. There should not be any distracting thoughts in your mind; At that time, the mind must be quiet to be able to perform this penance. That is the general meaning of using Chiem Sat Luan.

At first, when sowing [the wheel signs belonging to] the ten karma, because you do not know which karma is heavy in your body, mouth, mind, killing, stealing, lust, lying, double talk, embellished speech, harsh speech, greed, anger, ignorance, you can contemplate in general. After that, the focus is on repentance. Every day after repenting, you only sow the wheel of that karma, the other wheels are not sown. You must know that your body, mouth, and mind are not pure. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva said that sometimes seven days will be pure, sometimes one month, sometimes three months, sometimes half a year. If after three years you are still not pure, then there is no need to contemplate anymore, just specialize in reciting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's holy name. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will come to bless you, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will come to eliminate karma for you. That is specializing in practicing Ksitigarbha dharma, that is called contemplating good and evil karma. What is observed is your good or evil karma.

Why there are one hundred eighty-nine types, I will roughly explain to everyone. One hundred eighty-nine is divided into three lifetimes of retribution: The first one hundred and sixty types are the present life, [the things of] the past are many, the past includes eleven things, the future life includes eighteen things. That is the cause and effect of three lifetimes. Regardless of whether the present, past, or future is not pure, you can repent specifically. “Special repentance” is when you worship, you must face the Bodhisattva statue and express “What is the matter with the disciple, his karma is very deep”. Because you will be embarrassed in front of others, in front of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva you will not be embarrassed. You worship alone, alone before the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. If you don't say anything, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva also understands it clearly. Saying it means "exposing and repenting".

From number one to one hundred and sixty, one hundred and sixty numbers talk about [the events in] your present life, all the good and evil karma done in the present life are displayed. From one hundred sixty-one to one hundred seventy-one is to ask what we did in our past lives. If you roll a total of one hundred sixty-nine, it proves that in your past life you made offerings to Buddha and were born in this life. [The total number sown is] one hundred and seventy, which means making offerings to all the holy monks born in this life. One hundred and seventy-seven is to hear the profound Dharma. From one hundred seventy-two to one hundred eighty-nine, that is the future. Now this body gives up its retribution, where will it go? The third type of rotation has six rotations, you cast three times, sow the first time, sow the second time, sow the third time. The total number of three sowings, if it is one hundred and seventy-two, means that when you give up this body, where will it go? Go to hell. One hundred and seventy-three, if you let go of this retribution body, you will become an animal. One hundred and seventy-four, if you let go of this body, you will become a hungry ghost. One hundred and seventy-five, will become an Asura. One hundred and seventy-six, born in humans. One hundred and seventy-seven, born as a king in the human world. One hundred and seventy-eight, born in heaven. Continue like this, until you have planted [a total of] one hundred and eighty-nine, leaving this body, you will become a great Bodhisattva. You should consider for yourself whether or not you will attain this retribution, or the First Fruition, Second Fruition, Three Fruits, Four Fruits, or the Bodhisattva Vehicle. You compare each number like that.

Suppose you get a bad number, like I just said "the number one hundred and seventy-two". If you roll once you get this number, if you roll twice you also get this number. For seven days in a row, toss ten times, twenty times, it's all this number, absolutely not fake! Then you should repent, or continue to make special offerings, not just offering a few fruits and that's it, no way! After that, if you stay the same day and night, diligently work day and night, without sleep, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will be able to save you, help you escape from hell, and be reborn in humanity. After that, from being humane, you can go one step higher and be born in heaven.

[The number] one hundred and eighty-nine is due to six senses, six objects, six consciousnesses, three times six eighteen, plus basic ignorance to make nineteen, multiplied by ten lives. [Ten lives are] past, present, future, [each life has three lives, three times three makes nine, plus] a present thought makes ten. Ten multiplied by eighteen becomes one hundred and eighty, added to the past, present, and future, [each life has three generations] to make nine generations, [added together] becomes one hundred eighty-nine. That number (one hundred and eighty-nine) comes from that. We don't have time to continue talking about this, because to study, even to lecture takes a very long time. We had to spend so many hours to say it clearly, I still don't have this ability, don't have this ability, to introduce it to everyone a bit. When you want to deeply use the Contemplation Wheel, you must practice a lot. That's called "magic power". Or for someone you don't trust, you cast the Contemplation Wheel to see what that person is like? Luan General will tell you: You should not hang out with that person, he is a bad person! Please quickly refuse. [Luan General] says that person is a good person, so you can make friends. Of the same type, there are roughly ten numbers. Suppose we wish to live a few more years, we want to ask about longevity, you can sow. If you cast the number fifty-one, your life expectancy will increase. But this number is very difficult, don't think that this number is easy, this number is not fake. If you roll three times and get no numbers, it shows that you do not belong to the numbers, that is, you do not belong to the numbers of the human world, and you are not in the six paths. You have transcended the six paths, [so] there is no fate. Those numbers are the special teachings of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva. Where do they come from? From the Truth as it really is mentioned in the second half of the book [of the main sutra], relying on the truth, all good dharmas arise. Those one hundred and eighty-nine types are the specific situations of the Sutra on Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma. Everyone can request that sutra from Phuong Quang publishing house.

Dharma practice in the Sutra of Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma, originally composed by Master Ngai Ich. Later, completed and propagated by the magician Hoang Nhat, there was Chiem Sat Luan. When Master Nguu Ich wished to receive pure precepts, he looked in the Tripitaka, [found this sutra], and immediately bowed to Chiem Sat Sam. By bowing to Contemplation and Repentance, he attained the pure appearance of the wheel and attained precepts. It was not until Master Hoang Nhat received this method from Master Nguoi Ich that he promoted and propagated it again. Because Master Hoang Nhat studied art, he understood how to make Chiem Sat Wheel. The Contemplation Sutra does not mention this method of repentance at all. Great Master Nguoi Ich relied on other repentance dharmas such as the Great Compassion Repentance compiled by the Great Patriarch. Great Master Nguoi Ich composed the Contemplation and Repentance Dharma, down to the prayers, that is, the prayers were all written by Great Master Nguoi Ich.

At the same time, He also tells us: Based on the method of two types of contemplation to repent. In the Contemplation Sutra, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva teaches us: All sentient beings should study single-mindedness, causing their body, mouth, and mind to achieve purity. What is that pure appearance referring to? It is the pure form shown by the Contemplation Wheel; Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva did not elaborate. Study with a single mind, a single mind is sincere and earnest, the mind has no distracting thoughts, the mind is focused on repentance, to the point where you recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's name without distracting thoughts. [If a practitioner] bows for three years, but still does not attain the pure form of the wheel, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva says that He will still protect that person. That person has practiced for three years, and although he has not achieved the pure form of the wheel, he is still specially blessed and cared for by Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

Suppose you want to seek the Mahayana Dharma, to know at first what karma you still have, to know what basic karma exists, you should use the Contemplation Wheel. If you don't use the Contemplation Wheel, you don't know it yourself. You have to know the basic karma, the karma that exists but you don't repent, keep praying for Meditation, even learning all the dharmas, talking about the end of birth and death, you can't do anything! First of all, you must eliminate karma. If karma is not eliminated, it is impossible to practice those dharmas. Therefore, you must first repent of your karma!

When we explain, everyone knows that based on the Realm of One Truth, the innermost belief in the Realm of One Reality arises in faith and understanding, learning two types of contemplation, that is, dual-motion Contemplation: One is Mind-Only Consciousness, the other is Truth-Only General Contemplation. This dharma of repentance helps us practice, but when you practice, you become discouraged. Why do you practice for one year, two years, three years, ten years, without achieving anything? Depression! Use the Sat Luan Contemplation to identify which obstacles exist. After that, follow what Chiem Sat Luan teaches to repent. Having finished repenting, cultivating the realm of One Truth and two types of contemplation, you will be able to enter Samadhi of the Pure Mind very quickly, and your mind can be concentrated. If you don't know, just practice blindly and practice blindly, no matter how you practice, you won't be able to succeed! Just like when we try to turn rocks into rice, we absolutely cannot do it! If you repent of all [those karmic obstacles] and then practice again, once you practice, you will achieve it! That's because I don't know! If you want to know, you must first worship and use the wheel to sow. It is [Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva] that helps those of us who do not have supernatural powers to achieve supernatural powers. If you want to know whether your karma is heavy or light, plant the three wheel signs of body, mouth, and mind to see if they are red or black. Black is heavy evil karma, small [black line] is light evil karma. [Big, bold red line] is deep good karma, small [thin, short red line] is light good karma. First of all, know your karma or crime, know it clearly so that when you practice, you will know how to do it. Pure karma, you will naturally cultivate very easily, cultivating Concentration to attain Concentration, cultivating Hue to attain Hue.

This method is unique. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva especially compassionately teaches us to practice, which is called Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma. Use this method of contemplation to know whether you have deep good karma or heavy bad karma. You will know clearly in your heart! When you repent, you must repent to the main point, don't focus on the East for a moment, the West for a while, and after practicing, you still can't repent! You rely on this method of repentance, know what karma you have, and daily reveal it towards Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Every day, you worship once in the early morning. At first, practice for seven days [like this], or bow every day. After bowing, the wheel form is pure. You must preserve that purity, or create karma every other day, so you often use the wheel to remind you. Until you have just achieved [purity of the wheel of existence], your mind is pure, concentrated, concentrated on good karma, and will not regress anymore, then your faith can be complete. That dharma of repentance is a means to help us practice.

Furthermore, in life, lay friends who trade or do business, whether it is safe to travel on the road or not, whether the money used in business will make a profit or lose capital, first of all, sow the wheel of rotation to pray to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for [instructions]. But before that, you must meditate. It's not like if you think about it and just plant it, it will work! It doesn't work! Before that, you had already practiced according to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, and had a foundation for contemplation of the wheel of life, and your own good karma was very corresponding. When you contemplate, every time you contemplate, it becomes clear and pure. If you don't have it, you need to worship first. You have to pay the price to get the harvest. If you don't pay the price, there will be no harvest.

Until you sow [the reincarnation], what you achieve is purely the Ten Good Karmas. The Ten Good Karmas are completely not enough! That kind of goodness can only be practiced in cultivating the path, it is not formless repentance, it is not formless goodness. At first, we believe that Buddhas all have good karma, but you don't know which karma still exists hidden deep in your own thoughts. If you rely on the Contemplation Wheel to understand, you will know the main point. If you don't follow it, when cultivating the path, there will be obstacles and demons. You should plant the Chakra of Contemplation and stop to worship. After you have worshiped for a while, the negative karma and obstacles will disappear. At that time, it will be smooth and easy to practice the path. This special method of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva mainly helps you achieve your karma and your own faith. At present, lay friends, if you want your faith to not waver, please reflect a little often. But when you first start, you have to worship, either seven days, fourteen days, twenty-one days. Whenever you worship, your good karma and bad karma are stable, firmly placed in good karma, your mind is not placed in evil place. At that time, you can do whatever career you want.

In the beginning, it was best for three people to worship together, or at most no more than ten people. Everyone worships together and blesses each other. Even bowing alone is best, because each individual's karma is unrelated; But if one person worships, he is afraid of being lazy, [so we need] a little more people. Due to the strength of each other's blessings, you will not relax!

But when using the Dharma of Contemplation and Repentance, until you have finished repenting and have achieved the pure form of the wheel, you contemplate every day. Contemplating your own every move will be extremely effective. Because Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva teaches you, when you encounter any difficulty, or encounter something unfavorable, you should enter the Buddha hall to worship and receive blessings from Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. But now we chant Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva every time we recite it like that. Although it is effective, it is only a blessing in the human world, has nothing to do with the matter of being born in this world, and we hope to see birth and death come to an end! If you wish to leave the world and receive birth and death, your monastic friends must stop [the practice of the dharma you want to practice] for at least twenty-one days of three days of worship. By the time you finish repenting for twenty-one days, you will feel very pure inside. When you meditate or recite sutras, there will be times when you don't understand the principles that were previously very clear. After you worship, you will understand clearly for yourself. There are many Dharma friends who worship and follow Dharma Master Hoang Nhat's disciples in Singapore and the Philippines. Those people are no longer there, they have all passed away. They all rely on this method to practice to enter.

When the monastic friends worship, for the sake of birth and death, liberation, you should try bowing. When you use the Contemplation Wheel, beware of some obstacles. Firstly, you must be calm in your mind, don't rush to seek achievements. When it comes to eliminating karma, there is no such thing as taking advantage, don't expect to take shortcuts! As Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva said, let us follow Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's teachings like that, the effect will be very powerful! Don't do it halfway and then give up, either because you've just achieved the pure form, or if you see some realm in your dream and think you've achieved it. That test is not enough to attain concentration, it is necessary to attain concentration, in your mind you understand very clearly!

What is the definition? Your mind can truly see it. In the past, my own anger was very strong and I liked to get angry. If something doesn't please you, you'll get angry and irritable! Until you bow and repent, you have achieved purity, peace in your mind, and joy in everything you encounter. You will know the real effect that arises, you can test it yourself. Things that you couldn't let go of in the past now seem insignificant. Once you let go, you've achieved it. In life, in religious practice, in the past you always had nightmares. When you worshiped, from then on, nightmares did not appear. In the dream, if it is not a gathering of Dharma friends, then it is cultivating Buddha or Dharma, there is no other nightmare. Even in your dreams, you can be in control. I'm talking about in your dreams, or when you sleep, you all at once don't see the actions that belong to the Ten Evils, that go against the Ten Good Karmas! You know that you are truly cultivating and entering the good dharma door; At that time, practicing will easily attain enlightenment.

In the affliction section, I give an example: In the past, greed was very strong, very fond of money, very fond of some kind of item. Until you worship and practice for a period of time, it will naturally drop. Seeing that item, my heart was not moved, it was a success! You yourself can recognize and understand. In the past, afflictions were so severe that even when sitting still, one could not concentrate. Until you have been praying for a while, normally you sit quietly for one hour, but now you can sit for two hours, or three hours. When sitting still, you can be calm. It's a type. Like lay friends, no matter what they do, they always feel dissatisfied and do not go well. Until you can bow to one vent, two vents, three vents, without using the Contemplation Wheel, from life, you can experience the change for yourself. It's not the circumstances that change, it's your mind that changes. The appearance of the external realm will always be like that, but when your mind is good, [the situation] immediately changes. Whether or not your mind can change the situation depends on whether you have enough strength or not. If your power of repentance is strong, not only yourself, but also your family, as big as the temples of your masters, down to your friends, can practice together, you will know the great effect. Not only yourself, but also affects others. This matter does not require "casting a hexagram", you also understand clearly.

If you encounter something, you cannot decide for yourself, go into the penitentiary, contemplate for a while, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will decide for you, try many times without fail! So what is the benefit of practicing? Increase your faith, increase your faith. If you recite the Diamond Sutra, normally when you recite it, you will not be able to understand it. After you have bowed, you will be able to understand. Saying “can be explained” what does that sentence actually mean? That was in 1930 or 1931. When the old monk An Thuan in Co Son, Phuoc Kien province was vomiting blood, he returned to Putuo Son, staying in his own small temple to retreat. While in retreat, he reviewed the Tripitaka. While in Phuoc Chau, the doctor predicted that the Master would not live long! Vomiting blood non-stop, the Master suffered from very serious tuberculosis. The monk examined his organs for three years, recovered, lived to be a hundred years old, and was sick and weak all his life. That is absolutely blessed. Here, we rely on the blessings of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. You can ask questions at any time, you can ask for advice at any time, you can use wood wheels, but this needs to be learned. Today here, I just introduce to everyone a little bit. If you want to speak thoroughly and learn thoroughly, everyone must study with their own heart. If you have any questions, I will discuss with my friends again and correct mistakes.

It is like having a teacher, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, next to us. Sometimes when it comes to the wheel form, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva does not appear, or he does not come to protect the dharma, you cannot sow [the wheel form], from beginning to end there is no correspondence. The fact that you asked and [the result] of sowing the wheel of rotation does not match the two sides, which means you have not yet reached your sincere heart, which means your sincere heart is still not enough. Therefore, when you bow, it still does not cause your current obstacles and gross obstacles to disappear. At least when you worship, the coarse Or, coarse obstructions can disappear, and the new wheel form appears more and more beautiful. Or you have very heavy killing karma, killing karma of the type of anger and affliction, you naturally turn killing karma into compassion, showing that you have transformed. Not only not killing but also being compassionate, I understand very clearly. Therefore, the method of Contemplation helps us have supernatural powers and wisdom, but we must have sincerity. The first thing is to be sincere, the second thing is not to have any bad thoughts.

2. Dharma Contemplation

We have finished talking about the Contemplation Sutra, as well as explaining a little more to everyone about how to use the Contemplation Wheel for contemplation. There is also a method of repentance to worship. After you have bowed, you can use Chiem Sat Luan. Without repentance, how can you use Chiem Sat Luan properly? The repentance dharma for repentance was compiled by great master Nguoi Ich. Master Ich followed the teachings of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, he advised us to practice. Suppose you wish to attain birth and death, and wish to practice the Dharma, your practice will always have obstacles, due to incomplete conditions. Each of us Dharma friends, since becoming a monk, in the process of practice, you have always encountered many obstacles. We can still reluctantly accept the adverse conditions that go against our thoughts, and we can also know how to practice in the present adversity; But you don't know about the current situation. Everything is very favorable, everything is good, this is very dangerous, it will cause obstacles that will prevent you from practicing. That's called hindrance. In the midst of obstacles, there are advantages and disadvantages.

In the past life, we created the Five Adversities, the Ten Evils, the most serious and very heavy karma; In today's life, cultivating the Dharma faces many obstacles. Simply put, when we become monks and receive precepts, we cannot attain pure precepts. Four or five hundred years ago, during the Ming Dynasty, Master Nguu Ich hoped to find five pure monks in Nam Thiem Bo Chau, but could not find them. He has supernatural powers, not to mention that at present, we are separated for so many years, so when we worship, in our minds there will be the idea of ​​​​needing to practice the method of repentance. Whenever we worship, we practice repentance. From now on, if we don't do evil anymore and repent of the past, we will repent in the future and not do it anymore. That's called “repentance”. When you practice the method of repentance, the number of people should not be many! Everyone wants to practice together, a maximum of ten people. If you practice alone, it's even better. But there must be a teacher; When you pray and repent, many problems arise. There must be a master, that is, a teacher who understands this repentance method and shows it to you.

When you worship, you must use the Contemplation Wheel, but to use the Contemplation Wheel, there cannot be any concealment from Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. You must repent of your sins. You have private things in your mind that you don't tell anyone, but in front of the image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, you must say why you worship and what crime have you committed? If you yourself feel that you have a secret in your heart that you cannot tell anyone else, you should tell it to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

To show reverence in repentance, you must first calm your mind. When bowing, the first thing is to pay respect to the Buddhas of the ten directions; After that, make a vow, solemnly hold incense and flowers, according to the method taught by Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to practice: Make a vow, pray for this cloud of incense and flowers to cover all ten precepts. You visualize [like that]. If you can't do it, you have to rely on the text to recite. Make offerings to the Three Jewels, make offerings to all Buddhas, respect the Dharma as the Dharma Jewel, and the sage monks as the Sangha Jewel. Make offerings to all the Buddhas, Dharma, and Sangha of the Three Jewels, causing them to use your offerings as Buddhist work. These things are all there in the repentance text, everyone can follow the repentance text to recite. After that, the saint must be requested. Entering the penitentiary, you must first request a saint. The first thing to do is to invite the original Master Śākyamuni Buddha, Bhikkhu Buddha, the seven Buddhas of the past, up to Universal Buddha... that is fifty-three Buddhas, up to all the physical bodies, relics, images, stupas and stupas of temples, all the Buddha's works of all Buddhas. This repentance dharma was compiled by Master Nguich Ich based on the Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma Sutra [to compile]. All repentance dharmas are like that, but the Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma Sutra does not say; This is the Great Master Nguoi Ich who worships according to all the repentance dharmas. To serve and request all the Buddhas of the ten directions and three generations, and especially add the "Namo Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma and Retribution of the Wonderful Dharma Treasury". After we finished preaching this sutra, everyone had the impression: When you bow and repent, you must ask for the Dharma Jewel to appear, the dharma nature of the Dharma Jewel is like space. As soon as you pay attention, it appears. Because of Emptiness, there are no obstacles. After that, invite all the sages and monks. This sutra was requested by Kien Tinh Bodhisattva [said by the Buddha]. We repay His grace, when you worship, you must single-mindedly serve and invite the Bodhisattva of Steadfast Faith. Other sutras do not have [the name of this Bodhisattva], and other repentance dharmas do not exist. Only when you bow to Contemplation and Repentance can you worship and invoke Kien Tinh Bodhisattva. Must invite the Bodhisattva of the Sands of the Universe (Universal Sage Bodhisattva) and Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara). After that, I specially invited the master to repent, the master is Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. You also have to invite the dharma protectors, the dharma protectors are the Four Heavenly Kings, Brahma King, De Thich, the gods, and the celestial dragons of the eight groups. After that, you also have to recite the vow text. In that [repentance dharma] version, there are [the things just mentioned above], I just mention it, everyone should follow it to request and recite. I only ask Śākyamuni Buddha's father, the Seventh Buddha, the World-Honored One, the fifty-three Buddhas, all the enlightened ones [to prove and bless the practitioner], all invite those Buddhas. If I worship here, those Buddhas all have supernatural powers. They will wonderfully use and bless me. We also have to invite the Seven Buddhas of the past, the Buddha Bhikkhu. That's the vow I made when I worshiped, I didn't tell everyone in detail. Everyone should follow this Dharma repentance text to invite the fifty-three Buddhas. That is when in the penitentiary, just bowing, then, wholeheartedly respect the Dharma. After asking Buddha, he asked Dharma. After requesting the Dharma, all forms, relics, stupas, temples, and all the Buddha's work that has been done by the Buddhas of the ten directions must also be requested. The Buddhas of the East, South, West, North, and ten directions must also be invited. Finally, request all the Dharma treasures. In addition, ask for the Sutra of Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma. Based on the repentance of the Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma Sutra, everyone can request and recite it according to the repentance, I will not introduce it in detail.

But there is a passage compiled by Master Ngo Ich that is very effective for us. Vows, what vows? I and all sentient beings, from the beginningless time until now, through the three karma of body, mouth, mind, six sense organs, eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, and mind, have committed very serious sins. That's why we don't see the Buddhas, nor hear the Dharma spoken by the Buddhas, flowing in accordance with birth and death. Now we want to end it, because now we have heard the Sutra of Contemplating Good and Evil Karma, cutting off the stream of birth and death. Not only do we cut ourselves off, but we also pray that all sentient beings in the dharma world will also break with us, cut off all karma, eliminate the three hindrances, and sincerely repent.

There is a passage we must learn to recite: I and other sentient beings, from the beginningless time until now, because of love, on the inside, compare "me, others", on the outside, they add evil friends, not rejoicing in the least bit about the good of others, just all three karmas are extensive, creating sins. Although the matter is not extensive, the evil intention is all-pervading, day and night continuously, without interruption, hiding, avoiding mistakes, not wanting others to know. Don't be afraid of evil, don't be ashamed, don't be ashamed, reject the ten types of cause and effect. Now in the penitentiary, I repent completely of those ten types. Transform into a deep belief in cause and effect, give birth to great shame, give birth to great fear, reveal repentance, cut off the connected mind, develop Bodhi mind, cut off evil, cultivate goodness, three karma of diligence. Correct old mistakes, rejoice in the goodness of saints, even if just a little. At the same time, think of all the Buddhas in the ten directions, and the blessings and wisdom of the Buddhas are complete and perfect. All Buddhas can save us and eliminate the crimes we have committed from beginningless eons until now. The Sutra of Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma finally teaches that "nature is without death". Therefore, it is easy to repent. In our nature there is no [sin], it is just covered by all the afflictions. Now that I understand clearly, I study the Sutra of Contemplating Good and Evil Karma, knowing that [the nature] is empty, wishing for Bodhi, wishing for tranquility, praying that all sentient beings will join us in cultivating all good karma and eliminating bad karma. That is a revelation to request the Three Jewels.

After that, we sincerely repent, repent of our karma. That's what Great Master Ngo Ich did. I and all sentient beings, pure self-nature, One True realm, Buddhas have the same Body. Due to the accumulation of ignorance and ignorance, a false realm appears, causing us to develop attachments and false thoughts. There are also serious sins and light sins, causing our Concentration and Wisdom to be obstructed, causing us to cycle for a long time in the six paths, with no way to escape. Now we encounter the Sutra of Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma, which is the time for us to escape. As for external demons and internal obstacles, they all disappear. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva is the one who speaks well and comforts us, tears away the clouds of delusion, clears away the clouds of delusion and dreams for us, and cleanses and renews our minds again. I'm so sorry, I pray for repentance like that, I pray for repentance like that. After that, he again appealed to the Buddhas. These things are all there in the repentance text, but here I will briefly summarize them a bit. After that, there is also rejoicing in merit. Finally, you must wholeheartedly dedicate and dedicate the merit that I have cultivated to all sentient beings, repenting completely of all your sins, causing all sentient beings to repent completely of their sins. We hope that the Buddha family will be blessed and dedicate our merit of repentance and practice to all sentient beings in the ten directions. After that, he made another vow, praying that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and the Three Jewels of the ten directions would be protected by us. Our real world is not stable, our country is fragile. Currently, many disasters occur in the world and the Dharma is lost. We turn around, causing disasters to be eliminated, the Dharma to circulate, allowing all living beings to be able to have pure faith and mind, without obstacles. In cultivating the path, there are no evil obstacles, no wrong views, no wrong knowledge. Finally, bring the merit of learning, the merit of repentance, and dedicate it to the Pure Land.

Great Master Ngo Ich prayed all his life to be born in the Pure Land. This is a penitential text composed by Him. Not only being close to Amitābha Buddha, being born in the Pure Land world to being close to all the Buddhas, receiving predictions from the Buddhas and then returning to the world of dust, returning to the Sa Ba world to save sentient beings. That's called “making a vow”. Finally, pay homage to the Three Jewels. In the process of repenting and making vows, this is the last part while you go to the penitentiary to repent. This is like when you repent there is a certain order.

After you have entered the penitentiary, at first your mind is not yet concentrated, but when you enter the penitentiary, there are a few most important issues: "When you enter the penitentiary, your body and mind must be pure." Great Master Nguu Ich said: When you enter the penance room, your clothes must be clean. When you enter the latrine, Master Nguu Ich requires: It is best to have clothes specifically for use in the latrine, wear a coat, and when you go out, take off your coat and leave it in the latrine. Be sure to maintain purity. We enter the penitentiary, or enter the Buddha hall, Great Master Nguich Ich criticizes: [If the practitioner] is not pure at all, how can he achieve good results and receive blessings from Buddhas and Bodhisattvas? Compassionate Buddhas and Bodhisattvas will not compare, but the Dharma protectors will greatly compare. Your mind is pure, that's the main thing. There are Dharma friends who, after urinating and washing their hands, immediately enter the penance room. This is absolutely impossible! We saw many Dharma friends chanting sutras, but it was basically impure and they immediately went to the main hall. Therefore, Master Nguich Ich requests that if you can do it if your body is pure, your mind will also be pure. Only when the body and mind are pure can the blessing be achieved.

tieu_de: Lecture 17: Generating the Unsurpassed Bodhi Mind
tom_tat: Lecture 17 * Question: I often hear that developing Bodhi mind is the most important meaning in studying Buddhism. Is generating the supreme great mind the pure nature of the mind, for daily actions, speech, silence, movement, stillness, walking, standing, sitting, sleeping, etc.
noi_dung:
Lecture 17

* Question: I often hear that developing Bodhi mind is the most important meaning in studying Buddhism. Is generating the supreme great mind the pure nature of the mind? How should one develop daily actions, speech, silence, movement, stillness, walking, standing, sitting, lying? How to stay calm? How to protect? How does knowing one's own nature immediately correspond to that idea? Furthermore, how does the mind include great kindness, great compassion, great conduct, great vows, and great renunciation, so that from that mind it can be fully utilized and fully cultivated in the nature? I hope you teach me thoroughly!

Answer: Simply put, this Dharma friend asked about developing the mind: "What is developing the mind of Bodhi?" For Bodhi, we must first clearly understand what Bodhi is? Even if you don't understand Bodhi, how can you develop your mind? Bodhi is enlightenment in enlightenment. Bodhi is enlightenment, but also Buddha. The meaning included in “develop Bodhi mind” is “if we want to become a Buddha, you must develop Bodhi mind”. Developing Bodhi mind: Developing the mind is one thing, taking action is another! You have developed Bodhi mind, what will you do? You have developed Bodhi mind, rely on the mind you have developed to do things. Must follow each step. Of course, if you believe in the Three Jewels, if you believe in the Three Jewels, the Buddha is still the Bodhi mind, the Dharma is still the Bodhi mind, the Sangha is still the Bodhi mind. Every day you recite the Three Jewels to develop Bodhi mind, but what mind do you use to recite? When you develop Bodhi mind, you must use Bodhi mind to recite, that is, use the mind of enlightenment. If you wish for enlightenment, then it is one thing for you to develop your mind every day, and another thing for you to do. You should develop your own mind, body, mouth, and mind according to the Bodhi mind you have developed. Only then will you truly develop Bodhi mind. That way there will be no problem!

Answer: When you want to use the Wheel of Contemplation, the first thing you have to do is recite [the holy name Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva] first. It is possible that this Dharma friend has not heard the Sutra on Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma. The Contemplation Sutra teaches us: If you use the Contemplation Wheel, the first thing is to recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, or recite ten thousand sentences first. You still have to worship. You have to practice for seven days before you can use the Contemplation Wheel. This is not a problem, you must recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to be able to use the Contemplation Wheel, but it does not necessarily correspond. You say you just hope that as soon as you contemplate it, it will immediately correspond, that's not possible! You have to apply diligently for seven days, but you still don't see any correspondence, the main thing is: "The direct mind is the ashram". In your mind there are no other distracting thoughts, that is one mind.

Answer: You ask me this, I have no way to answer! What mind must you use to be enlightened and liberated? Everyone, please listen: What kind of mind do we students of Buddhism use to be enlightened and liberated? If you chant Buddha's name, chant it to the point of one mind, you can also be enlightened and liberated. Or worshiping to the point of one-mindedness can also lead to enlightenment and liberation. The problem is to reach one mind. If you are full of false thoughts; First of all, practice single-mindedness. One mind is one mind. The mind has the upper mind, the lower mind, and the middle mind. It is not easy for you to achieve the mind of the summer will, the mind of the summer spirit is one mind without chaos. When you practice, control all distracting thoughts and delusions, do not let your mind have distracting thoughts or delusions. Use that mind to bow, to pray, when you will be enlightened, when you will be liberated, depending on how much effort you put into it. Now I am still not enlightened, nor liberated, but if you want to achieve the same level of practice as me, it will take eighty years.

* Question: The mind always abides in the Buddha's name, sometimes pure, sometimes confused and confused. In general, there is no way to keep it permanent, so what should we do?

Answer: [Saying] “your mind is always in the Buddha's name” means you have to recite the Buddha's name yourself, not “your mind is always in the Buddha's name”, but the mind in which you often recite the Buddha's name. You don't say any Buddha's name. If you recite Amitābha Buddha's name, it is also the Buddha's name, and if you recite Śākyamuni Buddha's name, it is also the Buddha's name, and the Buddhas of the ten directions are also Buddha's names. Reciting any Buddha's name is fine. Now you [ask the Buddha's name] "Sometimes you achieve purity, sometimes you are confused and confused, there is no way to keep [purity] permanent, what should you do?" Regardless of whether you recite the Buddha's name or practice other dharmas, the first thing is to reach one mind first. Temporary purity is temporary, not yet achieved. Today, at this time you recite the Buddha's name purely, chanting to the point of being single-minded and undisturbed. Tomorrow you won't be able to do it. That's not called one-mindedness. At any time, any thought can reach purity, only then can you open knowledge, gain enlightenment, or seek rebirth, which is considered an initiation. It's not a success, it's just an “entry”. If you can be single-minded and always unmoving, it is an achievement. Temporary purity doesn't count, everyone has it! That friend only needs to believe that: As long as you are a disciple of Buddha, you can temporarily be pure for an hour or two hours, or be pure for a day, but it takes a long time. Becoming a Buddha is not a day. Achieving purity in one day means you have to practice for a long time to be able to concentrate your mind.

* Question: The Patriarch once said “getting the precepts is easy, keeping the precepts is difficult”. Especially in the Dharma-Ending Age, keeping the precepts pure is indeed not easy. Wanting to keep the great precepts (bhikkhus, bhiksunis) pure is even more difficult. Isn't it enough that we should keep the Ten Precepts, making it more difficult to break them?

Answer: “Getting the precepts is easy, keeping the precepts is difficult”, you are so right! During the Dharma Ending period, if you want to keep the precepts of a Bhikkhu or Bhikkhuni pure, it will be even more difficult! You are not a monk, nor are you a nun, you can talk about your own duty! It is not easy for Bhikkhus and Bhikkhunis to keep the precepts, so is it easy for you to keep the Three Refuges and the Five Precepts? You have received the Three Refuges but you are violating them all! Tell me, if you have received the Three Refuges, will you commit a crime or not? Obviously you have taken refuge in Buddha, but go to fortune tellers, cast hexagrams, or believe in pagan religions. Taiwan has a lot of religions, so it's like you've broken the Three Rules. Having broken the Three Refuges, one cannot be considered a disciple of Buddha! It is not the Five Precepts being broken at all, but the Three Refuges being broken. Can we keep the ten precepts? I see that you cannot keep the ten precepts! It's not easy! You have received the Three Refuges, can maintain the Three Refuges, and will not lose your human and heavenly blessings, do you know that? As for the ten precepts, looking at you like that, the ten precepts have not yet been received. Let's talk later! You can receive a few precepts and then keep a few precepts, there is no limit to the ten precepts. Regarding the difficulty of breaking the precepts, I have a contrasting view to yours. I feel that it is easier for you to break the precepts!

Answer: This friend asked me, "When can I reach the realm of One Truth?" I can clearly answer you that this life cannot be done! Achieving the realm of One True Reality is an accomplishment, we often say “enlightenment”. Enlightened, not reaching the One True realm, but clearly understanding the One True realm. We preach the Sutra of Contemplating Good and Evil Karma, which says very clearly: Participate in the Bodhisattva's first position. Completing the Ten Faiths, having participated in the First Pillar throne, can be considered similarly pure, not truly pure. If you are truly pure, then you can reach the Bodhisattva First Level and then you can be pure and no longer commit any transgressions. Do you understand or not? After you have repented of the three pure karmas, when explaining the Contemplation Sutra, we have said very clearly that you are considered to belong to the Faith. The three karmas are pure, if you believe, truly believe in the Three Jewels, your body, mouth, and mind will no longer commit sins, [however], they are not ultimately pure. Only Buddha and Buddha can achieve ultimate purity.

* Question: Using the Contemplation Wheel, early in the morning every day, use the second type of wheel to contemplate the body, mouth, and mind. For two consecutive days, for each karma of body, mouth, and mind, sown three times, good appearances will be sown. I would like to ask if that is considered pure or not? After that, how should we continue to practice and practice?

Answer: [The layperson asked] "Using the Wheel of Contemplation, using the second type of wheel of reflection to contemplate the body, mouth, and mind, for two consecutive days, for the three karma of body, mouth, and mind, if you sow three times, you will get good signs. I would like to ask if that is considered pure or not?" You use the Contemplation Sat Wheel, the Contemplation Sat Wheel shows that you are all red, have no black karma, then you are considered pure. The three karmas have been purified, which means turning evil towards good, only being counted as good people (good people). Having that faith, you will be able to increase your faith. Just keep trying to practice!

* Questions: 1) I have a friend whose spine was seriously injured. When worshiping, if you follow the method of five feet sown close to the ground to bow, fearing the old wound will recur, can you use the method of bowing to pray instead of kneeling and bowing five feet close to the ground? If we use the method of bowing to repent, will it affect the effectiveness of repentance?

2) I have a relative whose body is weak, whose career is not favorable, who does not admit that he has bad karma, and who does not believe in the Three Jewels. For that type of person, using the method of reciting the holy name of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and worshiping to dedicate, will it cause that person to have faith in the Three Jewels, progress to reciting Buddha's name, studying Buddha, and worshiping Buddha? If I dedicate the Buddha's name to that person, can I shoulder the karma for that person?

Answer: [You ask] "I have a friend whose spine was seriously injured. When worshiping, if the five bodies bow, fearing the injury will arise again, can I bow or not?" You can sit and pay your respects. You just sit, meditate and bow to the Buddha. In your mind, contemplating while bowing is considered pure, focus on the mind, not on form, do you understand? You have a relative whose body is weak, his career is not going well, his business is not profitable, he does not want to admit that he has karma, he clearly has karma, but he refuses to admit that he has karma, does not believe in the Three Jewels. For such a person, using the method of reciting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and praying, will it cause that person to have faith in the Three Jewels? This has no standards at all. Regarding this question, you should advise that person and make him or her develop faith in the Three Jewels first. The Buddha taught us very clearly, Buddha Dharma is as deep as the ocean, only through faith can we enter. That person has no faith, how can he practice, and what can he say about worshiping? Then you have to advise that person until he changes and has faith. Faith is the first step. If we want to achieve faith as we said while teaching the Sutra of Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma, the distance is very far. Because to cultivate faith in the mind, it takes ten thousand lifetimes, we all have the same mind.

* Question: Can lay people use the wheel to contemplate good and evil?

Answer: This Dharma friend asked me: "Can lay people use the Contemplation Wheel?" You ask me, I have been teaching this Contemplative Wheel Sutra for more than a month, have you listened or not? If you don't listen, you won't know. If you listen, you will know. So whether you can use Contemplation of Karma or not, let's review the Sutra of Contemplation of Karma from the beginning and you will see. If I were here to preach the Contemplation Sutra again, there would be no time.

* Question: Once you have realized the Dharma of Forbearance, do you still worship?

Answer: Let's not talk about entering the Dharma of Non-Birth forbearance, the Buddhas of the ten directions are all worshiping, do you understand? The Buddhas of the ten directions pay homage to the Buddhas of the ten directions.

* Question: We often hear "Buddha has difficulty saving ungodly people", but when Bodhisattvas cultivate in the human realm, the merit of their virtuous deeds are dedicated to all sentient beings in the dharma world, isn't that the same as forming a relationship with all sentient beings? Why is it that until we become Buddha, there are still sentient beings who have no fate and cannot be saved?

Answer: Dear friend! You go out and ask those who don't believe in Buddha, ask anyone at random, ask if that person has a predestined relationship or not, see how they answer. Say "Buddhism is difficult to save people without predestined relationships", they don't believe, if you don't believe, how do you save them? What is the standard of conditioned and unconditioned? There is a standard of credit. If one does not believe, one will absolutely not be able to enter; that's the standard. The premise is that the person does not believe, that is ungodly. If you are ungrateful, you will not be saved.

* Question: 1) Is it true that for sins that cannot be told to others, we must recite them once each time we repent?

3) Is there an old shaman's ashram in Taipei for group meditation?

Answer: Sins cannot be told to others, so you should worship, either bow to Ksitigarbha, or bow to Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattvas all know. You don't say anything, Bodhisattva still knows. When you confess towards the Bodhisattva, it is called “repentance disclosure”. If you trust the Bodhisattva, don't hide it, the Bodhisattva doesn't need you to say it, he still knows! Why do we still ask you to reveal your repentance? Express your mind! Just like when we throw away an item, we realize that repentance means letting go and not committing that crime again. That's the meaning. Do you hide Bodhisattva? Even from the demons you can't hide it! Demons and gods all have magical powers. How many times a day must I worship Contemplation and Repentance for the three karmas to be pure? It's not that you bow to Chiem Sat Sam several times a day, but you bow to pray for Chiem Sat Sam's pure appearance. It's not a matter of several times a day, but of worshiping every day. There is no number of times to test! Only when you reach purity will you bow. “Does the old magician have an ashram in Taiwan?” No! Is there a repentance room to practice Contemplation and Contemplation? No! In Taiwan, I don't have an ashram.

Answer: It is said that the Sutra of Contemplation of Good and Evil Karma and the method of worshiping and practicing this repentance, except for the sincerity and reverence of the mind, according to the practice established by Great Master Tri Jia to perform, will be identical. [Regarding what] we are talking about about Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Contemplation and Repentance, if you follow the method of contemplation of Great Master Wisdom, you should also [pay attention] to the same thing. Great Compassion Repentance or many other methods of repentance are the same, you just need to have a sincere heart. Using the Contemplation Wheel, calling the holy name is inevitable, you must recite it. Because Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva teaches: When you want to use the Contemplation Wheel to worship, you must recite a thousand verses of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's holy name. Recite a thousand sentences before using [Contemplation Wheel]. When you use it and it doesn't work, you should bow and recite. Once spiritual, spiritual is not the end. If you bow to the point where it is effective, it means that you use the Contemplation method and it will be effective and can be compatible. The repentance dharma aims to teach you to repent whether your karma is pure or not. To repent purely, you must bow and bow with the hope of attaining enlightenment. If we do not repent purely, we must repent purely. If you are pure, you will not receive retribution, that's the problem. “Correspondence” means that what you think in your mind and the teachings in the sutras, your way of thinking and the appearance mentioned in the sutras match closely, it is called “correspondence”. If you think but it is not like the sutras taught, it is called “not corresponding”. What is incompatibility? It's that your mind is still not sincere. Please practice again until your mind is sincere, then it will correspond. Correspondence to tell you what? Shows that you are guilty, you should repent, that's the meaning. Pure repentance is absolutely not the same as becoming a Buddha. Once your repentance is pure, you can practice the Dharma. Practicing the Dharma will be able to achieve success, studying the Dharma will be able to reveal wisdom, which has this meaning. Repentance is just repenting of sins, the first step to repent of sins in order to practice. There is no more sin, is it not pure? There is no sin, you practice Contemplation, the power of contemplation is pure, that is when you can learn the Dharma, can enter, open wisdom, see the sutras yourself and understand. When you attain concentration, your mind is pure, you can attain Concentration, you can enter Concentration.

Answer: You ask about this situation, I don't understand what you're asking? [You say] "from page forty-nine to page fifty-seven in the main sutra of Contemplation and Practice, you must recite it once first!" There is no way to say that! When you worship, it is for the karma [displayed by the form of the wheel], the repentance dharma teaches you how to worship, how to arrange the Buddha hall? When arranging the Buddha hall, you should follow the teachings of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva in Contemplation and Repentance, you must first bow to the Buddhas first; After that, bow to the Bodhisattva. After bowing, recite a thousand verses of Ksitigarbha's holy name, following that order to worship. If your body cannot bow and repent, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva creates the most convenient means for you, which is to recite ten thousand verses of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's holy name every day, which will be no different from repentance. While teaching the Contemplation Sutra, I spoke very clearly!

* Question: Please tell me how to repay your parents' kindness? What sutras should you chant or do anything else?

Answer: This question is "how to repay the kindness of parents? Can reciting sutras repay the kindness of parents, or practicing other things?" I answered with one word, “nang” (possible).

* Question: Master Amitābha Buddha, everyone says “no self”, but when I chant the sutras I often discover two Egos. One is the true Self, and the other is within your body. The inner Self is not shaken by the emotions of the outer Self, but follows the outer Self to chant sutras. I didn't say it, I felt that it was the Self's nature, I didn't know if it was true or not? Others say that I am "a ghost of a man", but I don't feel like that myself! It's just that the blind disciples practice blindly, they just like to recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra, there is no teacher to teach them, sometimes they really panic and fear. Thank you master for your explanation.

Answer: [You said] “master Amitābha Buddha”, master is not Amitābha Buddha! “Everyone says there is no self,” who said it? Everyone says there is no self, Buddha says it, no one says it. The Buddha told us that we must all realize that the Buddha's teachings are selflessness. But [he said] when chanting, you will often feel that there are two Egos. I see there are more than just two Egos. You have countless Egos, one moment there is one false thought, the next moment there is another false thought. [He said] "one is the true self, the other is the inner self", and that's it! The mind is very chaotic, we don't even know ourselves. The two Egos are his incarnations. The inner Self will not follow the outer Self. I see you always follow the outside. That's a mistake! How can one person have two Egos? No! There is only one Self, the Self is me. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's hundreds of thousands of millions of incarnations are just one. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra says: After Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva bowed to the Buddha, he brought hundreds of thousands of millions of incarnations into one body, that is, one. Fellow monks! There is a problem with your thinking, don't be so confused! Having delusions will easily lead to ghosts. Not only is the practice unsuccessful, but it is also susceptible to demons. He also [assumes] that there is an inner Self following the outer Self and chanting together, which is not correct. The person chanting the sutras is the Self chanting the sutras. Is there still an internal Self and an external Self! People say that he is "a fire-breather and a demon" and it's not wrong, it's very true! He himself felt that it was not like that, it was just “a blind disciple practicing the blind”. Since you know that you practice blindly, why don't you return to the right path? [He said] "I like to chant the Ksitigarbha Sutra, but without a teacher to teach me, sometimes I get very panicked and scared." When reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra, don't be afraid. Why? Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva will bless you, there is no need to be afraid. From now on, he only has one person, not two. He did not reincarnate, his incarnation was the devil, there is no such thing! You think about it sideways, chanting sutras, and wandering around outside, are these two Egos? No! Collect your mind, just single-mindedly think of the Ksitigarbha Sutra, false thoughts will disappear. Otherwise, you will be haunted by ghosts!

* Question: 1) The sutras from the perspective of an ordinary person like me, each sutra is extremely superior, and must be read and recited for a long time. Sometimes ordinary people want to read this sutra, sometimes they want to change to another sutra. Is that good or not? Regarding the Medicine Buddha Sutra, if we just recite the Medicine Master Praise and recite the Medicine Buddha's name, is it okay?

2) To repent and eliminate karma, which sutra should you read and recite? Or chant the Ksitigarbha Sutra? How to chant? How to dedicate?

3) Should we recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva, or Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva?

Answer: [He wondered] "The scriptures from the perspective of an ordinary person like me, each set of sutras is extremely superior, and must be read and recited for a long time. Sometimes ordinary people want to read this sutra, sometimes they want to change to read another sutra, is that good or not?" Not good. Why is it not good? A set of sutras, regardless of chanting the Vajra Sutra, is the same as reading the Ksitigarbha Sutra. Whichever set of sutras you read, you must penetrate deeply. Reading is not reciting words! The sutras always have meaning, teaching you how to speak with your mouth, how to act with your body, especially the sutras teach your mind how to think. In any sutra, it teaches about the three karma of body, mouth, and mind. You should recognize it like that. You wish to read another sutra, maybe! You can read the entire Tripitaka if you want! But what should your mind focus on? What should you focus on? Just one point, any sutra taught by the Buddha [can be read, recited and practiced]. Unless you review the scriptures, you must live in such a way that your mind corresponds to what the sutras have taught. Every sutra teaches you to "cut off greed, anger, and delusion; to develop Precepts, Concentration, and Wisdom", but the theme is the same: "Makes you eliminate delusions and reach the truth." Recite with your mouth and with your mind. Reading the Medicine Master Sutra, just chanting the Medicine Master Sutra and reciting the holy name of Medicine Master Buddha, that's right, very good. Then you specialize in reading the Medicine Buddha Sutra and reciting the holy name of the Medicine Buddha; That's called “penetrating a subject”. [He wondered again]: "To eliminate karmic obstacles, what sutras should we repent and read? Is the Ksitigarbha Sutra okay? How to recite it? How to dedicate it?" You recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra, in the Ksitigarbha Sutra there are [full steps to worship]. “Chanting” is reciting, reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra has a dedication part, the first part is intended to trigger the next part, the last chapter is the dedication. In each sutra, the first part is the initiation, the second part is the dedication. After reciting that sutra, dedicate the merit from reciting that sutra, of three types:

1) One is to dedicate Buddha's superior wisdom, wishing to become a Buddha like Buddha.

2) Second, it must be directed towards sentient beings, so that all sentient beings can become Buddhas.

3) But the most important thing is to dedicate it to yourself in the present life, eliminating your sins in the present life.

[He wondered] “Should I recite Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Mahasattva or Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva?” Those two titles have no difference. Reciting Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat, Ma Ha translates as Great, that is, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat. The reason why it is Bodhisattva Ma Ha Tat is because among the Bodhisattvas, the great Bodhisattva added the name Ma Ha Tat, that is, the great Bodhisattva among the Bodhisattvas. Just like us, a person is called a “great person”, meaning that person has a big heart, great blessings, and has that meaning. Ma Ha Tat was then translated as the great Bodhisattva among the great Bodhisattvas.

* Question: 1) When a disciple uses the Wheel of Contemplation, hoping to observe the wheel to know his own good and evil karma and to ask questions on behalf of his family, his family is not enthusiastic, nor does he come to the place to participate. I would like to ask, after contemplating and inviting Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, when it comes to reciting the holy name of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, can I recite two thousand sentences to ask questions about myself and my family members?

Answer: You asked about using Chiem Sat Luan on behalf of others, all right, no problem! You use the Contemplation of the Wheel of Contemplation on behalf of your family member to see if that person's karma is heavy or light, or if he or she is suffering from an illness. If you want to contemplate when that person will heal, what karma he has, you can also recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra to relieve that person's troubles. Doing so is correct. Or recite the holy names of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. If you recite the holy name Ksitigarbha, can you recite two thousand sentences? You are determined to recite ten thousand sentences, which means reciting a lot. You set two thousand verses and then recite two thousand verses, but every day you have to recite two thousand verses. At the same time, you intend to take one beating, which means fixing it for seven days, or two vents, meaning fixing it for another seven days. During meditation, [if you estimate] to recite two thousand verses every day, then recite two thousand verses. [Evaluate] recite ten thousand sentences, then recite ten thousand sentences. Depending on your own time, depending on your own wishes, there are no certain requirements! But when reciting, don't just recite the name alone! The mouth recites, the mind thinks, [that is] the mouth recites the name, the mind contemplates the holy image of the Bodhisattva, the mind and mouth are as one. If you just chant, the effect of the chant will not be great, the most important thing is to visualize.

* Question: 1) To recite Buddha's name to seek birth in the Pure Land, one must first practice the method of repentance, right? If we do not practice the method of repentance, will rebirth be hindered?

2) Why are there people who recite Buddha's name when they are about to die and become drowsy and unconscious? How to avoid that situation from arising? How should we support Buddha recitation for unconscious and drowsy people?

Answer: Are you wondering "if reciting the Buddha's name to seek birth in the Pure Land, do we need to practice the method of repentance first?" No need! Reciting Buddha's name and praying to be born in the Pure Land, you recite Amitābha Buddha's name and pray to be born in the Pure Land. If you practice the method of repentance, in the method of repentance there is also Buddha's name, the two sides are not contradictory, there are no obstacles! Why is there an obstacle? The method of repentance increases your sincerity in reciting Buddha's name. You repent, the method of repentance is to repent for a period of time and then recite Buddha's name again, having recited Buddha's name and then restore the practice of repentance. Both sides help each other achieve, without harming each other! Why are there people who recite Buddha's name and when they are about to die, they become drowsy and unconscious? Those are two different things. Drowsiness and unconsciousness are one thing, but it is absolutely not the case that the person reciting Buddha's name has no merit. The merit of reciting Buddha's name still exists, but that person does not recite Buddha's name successfully. If you recite the Buddha's name successfully, you will not be lethargic. But what about getting sick or sleeping at night? It's not that people who recite Buddha's name don't sleep, people who recite Buddha's name also have to sleep. Can you still recite Buddha's name after sleeping? Everyone, think about it, if your recitation of Buddha's power is very strong, when you sleep, your mind reciting Buddha will not be interrupted, your thoughts will not be interrupted. When you dream, do you chant Buddha's name? I see a lot of people have it, day and night they constantly have [the idea of ​​reciting Buddha's name]. This requires relying on force, not an ordinary person can do it. Reciting Buddha's name to attain rebirth in the Pure Land does not require you to practice repentance. If you recite Amitābha Buddha's name, you have repented. All sutras say “rebirth of karma”, that saying is very common. We are in this world, the three karmas are still not pure, but reciting the Buddha's name is very focused, all karmic obstacles cannot be cleared away, but reciting the Buddha's name is immediately reborn in the Pure Land. It is absolutely not necessary to reach the Pure Land and become a Buddha. You still have to practice. Most [people who are reborn] carry karma with them. If in this world there is no karma, is pure, and accomplished, what is the point of being born in the Pure Land? That person also created a world, everyone should understand this principle! Reciting the Buddha's name and falling into drowsiness at the time of death is absolutely not the case that just reciting the Buddha's name can solve everything! Depends on how powerful you are! That person doesn't have enough strength and doesn't fall into drowsiness? If we say people recite Buddha's name, why do they still get sick? I said Śākyamuni Buddha was still sick. It is a worldly disease, caused by the six senses not being in harmony. This body is the form of the world, your spirit is the spirit, that is the real thing. How to avoid this situation from arising? How can we avoid this type of situation from arising? So when you don't feel lethargic, use it wisely and you will be able to eliminate lethargy. We saw that while reciting Buddha's name, many people fell asleep and fell asleep. Right in the Buddha's Recitation Hall, you see that when the Buddha is beaten, his spirit is tired. I was once in an ashram with people reciting Buddha's name, [saw] some people who were meditating and reciting Buddha's name while following the crowd and falling asleep, but still walking. Don't see that person following the crowd [and think wrongly], that person is still sleeping. Like when I explain, many people sit and listen, their eyes wide open, but they are sleeping! Open your eyes and still be able to sleep? In history, many people kept their eyes wide open and still slept. Truong Phi slept with his eyes wide open, just like that.

* Question: 1) Currently, when a disciple has just started bowing to Ksitigarbha Contemplation Sam, can he help his family members bow at the same time? Or should we wait until we have been bowing for a while and then help our family members bow together?

Answer: [He asked] I have just started bowing to Ksitigarbha Sam, can I help my family members bow together? Very good! Not only can you save yourself, but you can also save others. Whether people will bow to you or not is the problem here. Or if you are the homeowner, forcing others to bow to you, the effect will not be great. Advise your family members, tell them the benefits of bowing to Buddha. If he is doing business and hopes to get rich, you tell him to bow to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and he will get rich, he will absolutely listen to your words and bow. That person's body is very weak, you advise that person "follow me and worship Buddha, your body will be healthy". Praying to Buddha not only has the power of movement but also the power of blessing. It can indeed achieve results very quickly. You still have to ask me about this, you should understand! When you bow to Buddha, you make a vow. When you bow, you must first make a vow, and lastly, dedicate. Every disciple who learns something, even if he recites a single sentence of Amitābha Buddha, must make a vow. Why should we recite Buddha's name? Simply, at least I want to be born in the Western Pure Land. Why should we recite Buddha's name? Because of Buddha's blessing! What is blessing you? Only when you have a wish do you recite it. This issue is very simple, this is a vow, do you understand? It's the same when you bow to Ksitigarbha. First, make a vow. Once you make a vow, then start practicing. After practicing, he still dedicates himself. Those are three types of sequences. No matter what sutra you recite, you must first make a vow. Make a vow and then practice. After practicing, you still have to dedicate it. Early in the morning you wake up, enter the Buddha hall, the first thing is to make a vow. After making the vow, you then recite the merits. After reciting the merits, you must dedicate it. This is a certain order, Buddha's disciples all do the same. I still ask if this is possible or not? I answer you, maybe! Not only can it be, but it should be like that!

* Question: In the Sutra Contemplation of Karma, Vol. If you are a person of good taste, you should learn Contemplation of True Truth. Those with dull faculties must first learn Mind-Only Consciousness Contemplation, from Mind-Only Consciousness Contemplation they attain Samadhi of Form and Consciousness. Next, you should learn to have faith in the mind contemplation method with Xa Ma Tha and the mind contemplation method with Vaibhava Na. Also, if you are a person with weak good karma, doubtful and fearful mind, at all times, in all places, you should often chant my name... If you attain one mind, good roots grow, and your will is strong and sharp, contemplate my Dharma Body and the Dharma Bodies of all Buddhas. In the sutras, it is mentioned that the Contemplation of True Truth, the believer Xa Ma Tha contemplates the mind, and contemplates the Dharma Bodies of the Buddhas. Is there a difference in order and depth for that Contemplation and its content?
